Class Controller

    • validateBookingForm

      private boolean validateBookingForm(javafx.scene.control.ComboBox<Vehicle> vehicleBox, javafx.scene.control.ComboBox<Employee> employeeBox, javafx.scene.control.ComboBox<Campus> campusBox, javafx.scene.control.DatePicker startPicker, javafx.scene.control.DatePicker endPicker, javafx.scene.control.TextArea output)
      Checks if a booking is a valid booking.
      Parameters:
      vehicleBox - to get the vehicle for a booking from.
      employeeBox - to get the employee for a booking from.
      campusBox - to get the dropoff campus for a booking from.
      startPicker - to get the start date for a booking from.
      endPicker - to get the end date for a booking from.
      output - where to output whether the booking is a valid booking or not.
      Returns:
      true if the booking is a valid booking, false if not.
